description: GRF simulated Chelsea–Manchester United. Illustrative real-name lineups; not an actual match.

provenance.source: Google Research Football instrumented native runtime
limitations: Synthetic simulation, not official Opta data or an actual fixture.
Names map simulator slots; player abilities are generic.
Headed pass/shot classification requires an executed header with explicit native action intent.
Pass completion means first subsequent intentional teammate touch; event time is resolution.
Possession measures confirmed native ownership ticks; loose-ball and stoppage time excluded.
No inferred xG, successful tackles, interceptions, saves or on-target classifications; referee decisions and taken restarts are native observations.
provenance.contact_coalescing: Continuous same-player/function/type callbacks with gaps<=300ms form one action.
provenance.scoring_attempts: A linked scoredshot is represented once as goal; raw native shot remains in capture.
provenance.presentation: Each native half scaled independently to360 video seconds, including stoppages. Matchclock90 minutes; activephysics12 minutes.
